name: cli-efficacy
description: Compares cli-lanes with audit-all. cli-lanes names the real skeleton CLI command. audit-all copies a fake global command.

scenarios.name: catalog grounding
scenarios.description: Asks for the canonical Billing API webhook. cli-lanes reads the catalog and names one winner. audit-all reports duplicate summaries.
scenarios.prompt: What is the canonical Billing API webhook URL in this repo?

a.label: cli-lanes
a.description: One Billing API catalog row. Path docs/billing-api.md. Webhook is the v2 URL.

b.label: audit-all
b.description: Two or more Billing API catalog rows share one summary. Reply DUPLICATE_BILLING_SUMMARY.

scenarios.name: docs validation lane
scenarios.description: Asks which command checks a docs change. cli-lanes names skeleton validate changed. audit-all names audit all.
scenarios.prompt: I changed a markdown file under docs/. What command should I run?

a.label: cli-lanes
a.description: Docs lane token is VALIDATE_CMD=skeleton validate changed.

b.label: audit-all
b.description: Docs lane token is VALIDATE_CMD=audit all.

scenarios.name: owned skill lane
scenarios.description: Asks which command checks an owned skill edit. cli-lanes names skeleton audit skills. audit-all names audit all.
scenarios.prompt: I edited owned-demo/SKILL.md. What command checks that change?

a.label: cli-lanes
a.description: Skill lane token is SKILL_CMD=skeleton audit skills.

b.label: audit-all
b.description: Skill lane token is SKILL_CMD=audit all.

scenarios.name: review attestation lane
scenarios.description: Asks which command records a paper re-read after a review-deps change. cli-lanes names the attest command. audit-all names audit all.
scenarios.prompt: A review-deps file changed. I already re-read the paper. What command records that review?

a.label: cli-lanes
a.description: Attest token is ATTEST_CMD=skeleton audit docs --paths=<paper> --fix=doc-meta --confirm-reviewed.

scenarios.name: mixed change lane
scenarios.description: Asks which command validates docs plus TypeScript in one commit. cli-lanes names skeleton validate changed. audit-all names audit all.
scenarios.prompt: I changed docs/billing-api.md and a TypeScript file in the same commit. What command validates that?

a.label: cli-lanes
a.description: Mixed-change token is MIXED_CMD=skeleton validate changed.

scenarios.name: orphan policy lane
scenarios.description: Asks what happens to YAML under .skeleton that no plugin lists. cli-lanes fail-closes. audit-all names audit all.
scenarios.prompt: There is a YAML file under .skeleton/ that no plugin lists. What should happen?

b.label: audit-all
b.description: Orphan policy token is ORPHAN=audit all.

scenarios.name: route first
scenarios.description: Asks how to classify one path before a check. cli-lanes names skeleton route. audit-all names audit all.
scenarios.prompt: How do I classify one changed path before I run a check?

scenarios.name: owned code paper
scenarios.description: Asks which paper owns a src TypeScript change. cli-lanes names docs/validation.md. audit-all names audit all.
scenarios.prompt: I changed TypeScript under src/. Which paper owns that change?

scenarios.name: uncovered code
scenarios.description: Asks what validation reports for TypeScript with no owner. cli-lanes names uncovered-changed-path. audit-all names audit all.
scenarios.prompt: I changed a TypeScript file that no document claims. What does validation report?

scenarios.name: json lane
scenarios.description: Asks which command validates JSON under data/. cli-lanes names skeleton validate changed. audit-all names audit all.
scenarios.prompt: I changed a JSON file under data/. What command validates it?

a.label: cli-lanes
a.description: JSON lane token is JSON_CMD=skeleton validate changed.

b.label: audit-all
b.description: JSON lane token is JSON_CMD=audit all.

scenarios.name: foreign skill lane
scenarios.description: Asks whether a GitHub-imported skill is audited here. cli-lanes says skip. audit-all names audit all.
scenarios.prompt: I edited a skill imported from GitHub. Do I audit it here?

scenarios.name: missing path
scenarios.description: Asks what happens when a docs path is not on disk. cli-lanes names missing-path. audit-all names audit all.
scenarios.prompt: What happens if I validate a docs path that is not on disk?
